description: Permissions the yt2mp window needs: a native save dialog, revealing a finished file in the file manager, opening a post's original page in the user's browser (the only way to view TikTok/Instagram/X/Twitch content, which can't be embedded), and installing a signed update then restarting into it. github.com is allowed so a release page can be opened — on Linux an AppImage that wasn't launched as an AppImage cannot self-update, so it links to the download instead. Everything else (yt-dlp, the filesystem, the network) is reached through this app's own commands, never exposed to the webview directly.
